title: zero-native: a Zig desktop shell that gives your web app direct access to platform SDKs

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Electron ships an entire Chromium instance just to render your UI. Zero Native from Versa Labs is a desktop shell written in Zigg that calls C directly, giving your front end pure access to platform SDKs with zero glue code. Use the native OS web view for a tiny binary or bundle CF Chromium when you need pixel perfect consistency. Autoscaffolds Nex.js, React, Spelt or Vite with native build paths for Mac OS, Linux and Windows. WebTech desktop apps without the Chromium
